fact_text: The policy rate had been cut from about 22% to 11% over the year before the July 2025 meeting.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: Interest rate changes take about four to six quarters to fully unfold in the economy, so the analyst said the SBP is cautious about cutting again before the effects of earlier cuts show.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The SBP's inflation target for FY26 is an average of 5 to 7%, and the central bank tracks oil, commodity prices, the rupee and the external account against it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: Average month-on-month inflation in FY25 was about 0.3%, which pulled annual FY25 inflation down to about 4.3 to 4.4%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: Month-on-month inflation was running at about 2 to 2.5% in mid-2025, and the analyst said that momentum, including from floods, could push inflation higher.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The analyst said inflation could rise above 7% in some months after December 2025, a risk the governor flagged while the SBP's average target band is 5 to 7%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: Agriculture growth fell from about 5 to 6% in FY24 to under 1% in FY25, and good rains are expected to lift it in FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The primary surplus is projected to be above FY25 levels in FY26, with a smaller fiscal deficit, which the analyst said supports the SBP's targets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The current account recorded a surplus in FY25, the first in about 14 years, and the SBP projects a slight deficit of 0 to 1% of GDP for FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: Workers' remittances grew about 27% in FY25, a rate the analyst said is hard to project forward at the same pace.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The SBP expects remittances of about 40 billion USD in FY26, which the analyst considered a reasonable target given the growth seen in FY25.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The trade deficit grew about 21% in FY25, and the SBP expects it to keep growing, which the reporter presented as a risk to the external account.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: External debt repayments due in FY26 total about 25.9 billion USD, of which about 16 billion USD is expected to roll over.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: Net external repayments in FY26 are about 9.9 billion USD, excluding about 4 billion USD of interest payments, according to the SBP's projection.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: SBP reserves stood at about 9.5 billion USD at the end of FY24.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The SBP projects reserves of about 15.5 billion USD by Dec 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The SBP's reserves target is about 17 billion USD at end-June 2026.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The analyst expects the rupee to be somewhat volatile in FY26, which matters for the external account given the reserves and repayment profile.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The next SBP monetary policy committee meeting is scheduled for 15 Sep 2025.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The SBP plans eight monetary policy decisions in FY26, and the analyst said it may hold or cut depending on how inflation, oil and the external account develop.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: About one third of Pakistan's import bill is oil, so a rise in oil and other commodity prices feeds quickly into inflation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: Brent crude fell back to about 66 USD after the Iran-Israel conflict ended and was about 71 USD when the video was recorded.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The analyst said cement shares sold off and bank shares rose in the hour before the 3 pm decision, a pattern he read as an early signal of the outcome and a possible leak of the MPC result.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The analyst said a 50 basis point cut would not have made a significant difference to the economy, because the policy rate had already fallen from 22% to 11%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The analyst said private-sector growth in autos, pharmaceuticals and food had shown momentum for two to three months before the decision, and industry was gradually picking up.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The analyst said the SBP prefers stability over growth and that its actions are in line with IMF expectations, so the decision was read as a positive for the economy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Why SBP Maintained the Interest Rate | Monetary Policy Breakdown | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-30)

fact_text: The analyst said the SBP can anchor inflation and growth only partly, so the government needs structural reforms that lift exports and fix the fiscal side.
